# lsof compatibility — `org.ono.compat.lsof`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `lsof`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## lsof — `org.ono.compat.lsof.lsof`

Open files as `ono.open-file/1` records, from `lsof -F`.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `lsof` |
| versions | `>=4.89` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.open-file/1` |
| decoder | `lsof-fields-v1` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `lsof/lsof` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lsof [-n] [-P] [-i] [-U] [-p <pids>] [-u <users>] [-c <command>] [-d <fds>] [path …]` | `lsof -w -n -F pcuftn` | `-n`, `-P`, `-i`, `-U`, `-l`, `-b`, `-w`, `-p <value>`, `-u <value>`, `-c <value>`, `-d <value>`, `-a <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `fd` | `fd` |
| `kind` | `type` |
| `name` | `name` |
| `path` | `path` |
| `pid` | `pid` |
| `process` | `command` |
| `user` | `uid` |

### Limits

- Only the processes the caller may inspect appear; lsof warns on stderr about what it cannot stat, and those files are absent, not fabricated (spec v0.3 §1.40).
- `-F` with other fields, `-t`, `-r` and `+D` change the protocol or the shape and run raw.
- `path` is set when the kind is a filesystem object (`REG`, `DIR`, `CHR`, `BLK`, `FIFO`, `LINK`); sockets and devices keep their `name` only.
